meta.designed: The repo is a scaffold: values it does not define were designed for this system (see the README's Not synced note).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Brand constant (Tailwind slate-950), the same in both themes: the night-sky ground of the landing hero, which page.tsx paints whatever the color scheme. The dark theme's `surface`.

tokens.name: night-mid
tokens.usage: Brand constant (slate-900): the middle stop of the hero gradient, `night` → `night-mid` → `night`. The dark theme's `surface-alt`.

tokens.name: starlight
tokens.usage: Brand constant (slate-50): headline text on `night` and `night-mid` (17:1 or better). The dark theme's `ink`.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Brand constant (indigo-300): the brand's one accent — list dots, hover borders, progress — and a text color on `night` (10:1). The dark theme's `accent`.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Brand constant (indigo-200): eyebrows and overlines on `night` (13.5:1). The dark theme's `ink-accent`.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Brand constant (indigo-100): card and section titles on night glass (12:1 or better). The dark theme's `ink-title`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The root body color from globals.css (Tailwind `bg-background`), kept exact. App screens paint `surface` over it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: The root body text from globals.css (`text-foreground`), on `background` (17.9:1 light, 16.9:1 dark). App text uses `ink`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light is slate-50, an off-white that cuts glare for dyslexic readers; dark is `night`.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Wells set into a surface: chips, the segmented control's track, the progress-bar track. Dark is `night-mid`, the gradient's middle stop.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, task rows and panels. Dark is glass: white at 5% (page.tsx `bg-white/5`) over the night gradient, with `blur-glass` behind it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and row borders and dividers — decoration, never the only cue. Dark is white at 10% (page.tsx `border-white/10`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons. 4.3:1 or better in light, 3.3:1 or better on dark glass.

tokens.name: line-accent
tokens.usage: Hover and in-progress borders (page.tsx `hover:border-indigo-300/60`). 3.1:1 on white, 3.7:1 on dark glass.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, task titles and primary text on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `surface-raised` and `accent-soft` (15:1 or better in both themes). Light is slate-900, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy inside cards (page.tsx's card text is slate-200), chip and tag labels; on every surface (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs, metadata, hints, counters (page.tsx's intro is slate-300); on every surface and `accent-soft` (6.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, overlines, links, the selected segment's label and energy glyphs; on the surfaces and `accent-soft` (7.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-title
tokens.usage: Card, panel and step-list titles (page.tsx: indigo-100 on glass); on `surface` and `surface-raised` (12:1 or better).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, always underlined — an alias of `ink-accent`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action color: primary button fill, checked boxes, progress, the timer arc, list dots, the focus ring. 5.7:1 or better as a mark on every surface. Text on it is `on-fill`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and press.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the current micro-step, the selected segment, the Doing badge and the next-step nudge. Text on it is `ink`, `ink-muted` or `ink-accent`.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `accent`, `success`, `warning` or `danger` fill (5:1 or better light, 7:1 or better dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done: the checked task toggle and the Done badge; as text on the surfaces or `success-soft` (4.8:1 or better). Cyan rather than green so Done and `danger` differ without red–green vision; always with a check and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Done badge.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Gentle time cues only — "Due today", "Ends in 5 min". Never for late or missed work. As text on the surfaces or `warning-soft` (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a due-soon chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and field errors the person must fix. Never for overdue tasks. As text on the surfaces or `danger-soft` (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Hover tint of a danger button; background of an error summary.

groups.name: App
groups.note: Everything inside the product. Nothing is set below 14px; reading text gets 26px lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Start with a 25-minute focus block. You can stop any time.
styles.usage: All reading text — task descriptions, AI explanations — in `ink` or `ink-soft`, left-aligned, no wider than `measure`.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Anything you act on or scan for: task titles, button labels, field labels, segment labels.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Badges, tags and energy chips — always inside a pill, beside an icon or on a tint.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, hints and helper text, in `ink-muted`.

groups.name: Landing
groups.note: The landing page's hero and feature cards, exact from page.tsx (Tailwind v4 sizes).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set uppercase, in `ink-accent` (`glow-soft` on night), above a display line. Four words at most.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline from 640px wide, in `ink` (`starlight` on night). Once per page.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Turn complex tasks into micro-steps, get next-best actions, and let the app learn your rhythm.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline, in `ink-muted`, no wider than `prose-max`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Set uppercase, in `ink-accent`, over a short list or a nudge. Three words at most.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Built-in timer scaffolding plus spots for sound cues and dopamine boosts.
styles.usage: Feature-card copy on the landing page, in `ink-soft`. Inside the app use `body`.

groups.name: Numerals
groups.note: Geist Mono's fixed-width digits keep counting numbers from jittering.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The focus timer readout only, in `ink`.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Durations, step counts and character counters, in `ink-muted`.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale; the number is the Tailwind step, so `space-5` is `p-5`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Drops a list dot to the first line (`mt-1`); icon-to-label gap in chips; the segmented control's inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; between list items; title to body inside a card; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a toggle and its text; input side padding; tag side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid (`gap-4`); task-row padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Feature-card and step-list padding (page.tsx `p-5`).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding (`p-6`); the page gutter below 640px (`px-6`); between the timer's parts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section heading and the group of cards under it.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections (`gap-10`); the page gutter from 640px (`sm:px-10`).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page padding (`py-16`).

radius.note: Soft everywhere: nothing in the system is square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and the current-step highlight.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards, task rows, panels, the nudge (page.tsx `rounded-2xl`).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: List dots, chips, tags, badges, progress bars, the segmented control, round toggles (page.tsx `rounded-full`).

shadow.note: Light lifts cards with a soft shadow; dark is glass — borders and blur, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and task rows at rest (Tailwind `shadow-sm`).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Anything floating over the page: menus, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in `surface`, then 2px of solid `accent` (5.7:1 or better on every surface). A box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind dark-theme glass cards (page.tsx `backdrop-blur`); pair with `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Page content width (page.tsx `max-w-5xl`).

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs under a headline (`max-w-3xl`).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text in the app — about 65 characters.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for any standalone control; buttons, inputs and toggles are at least this tall.
